The disposition is blocked under D4.2 with blocked_reason=ibr_gate_gfl_threshold; add GFM capacity or synchronous condensers before approval, as the gate directs. PLAN D4.1/G2 is internally tense with D4.2: G2 requires an error-free PASS, while this domain tool returns an explicit BLOCK in the error field with result=null. For disposition and cause attribution, this BLOCK message is treated as valid domain evidence returning 34.8% post-expansion GFL and 60 MW added GFL; G2’s error-return condition is waived for that purpose only. G2 remains failed for approval. D4.2 and ibr_gate_gfl_threshold are retained to reflect BRIEF precedence and the actual cause. A literal D4.1 interpretation would also leave the request blocked. Synchronous condensers are quoted tool advice, not proven substitutes for GFM MW in this capacity-share gate; a revised GFM/GFL registry must pass the same gate, and any condenser proposal needs separate validated strength/stability evidence.

overall_verdict: IR-1 and IR-4 are approved at the planning-screen level, IR-2 is approved with the stated L-203 corrective condition, IR-3 is blocked by the Z-SOUTH GFL threshold, and IR-5 is rejected for the CRITICAL L-501|L-502 stability violation; none of these dispositions establishes N-0, N-1, SCR, or time-domain stability compliance.
limitations: N-1 not checked; N-0 power flow not run: the network model was unavailable, so base-case convergence, per-unit consistency, power balance, and NERC TPL P1–P5 N-1 compliance were not established.
SCR not assessed (no short-circuit data): zone_short_circuit_mva was absent, and the structured gate outputs returned grid_strength_assessed=false; no SCR, WSCR, or grid-strength class is claimed.

The N-1-1 findings rely on supplied post-contingency summaries rather than an independently solved network model, and the IR-5 stability result relies on the supplied stability_loss flag rather than a time-domain IBR simulation.
The IR-3 gate returned its BLOCK in the error field with result=null, so no structured post-expansion zone_assessment, GFL-headroom, or GFM-needed value was available for that call.
The inputs provide no MVA or bus kV base, so per-unit consistency and physical kV, A, MW and MVAr conversions cannot be established. No base or cross-network voltage comparison is assumed.
These are NERC TPL-001-4 P6/P7 planning-screen dispositions only, not regulatory filings or final interconnection approvals.
